title: Document Outline
description: Structured outline defining all sections, their purposes, and scopes. Required input for section drafters. Each section entry must be complete enough for a drafter to begin writing without asking clarifying questions.

brief_id.description: ID of the brief this outline was derived from

title.description: Document title — should match or refine the brief title

template_used.description: Template ID from templates/ if an outline template was applied

sections.description: Ordered list of all sections in the document

section_id.description: Unique identifier for this section within the outline

purpose.description: What this section accomplishes for the reader — must be distinct from all other sections

required_content.description: Specific content items, claims, or examples that must appear in this section

source_refs.description: Source file paths or guide IDs relevant to this section

estimated_words.description: Target word count for this section

subsections.description: Nested subsections, following the same structure as parent sections

notes.description: Additional guidance for the section drafter — approach, tone notes, or special handling instructions

total_estimated_words.description: Sum of all section estimated_words — must fall within the brief's word count constraints

structure_justification.description: Explanation of why sections are in this order — must be reader-logic justification, not production order

created_by.description: Agent ID that created this outline

run_id.description: Cache run ID this outline belongs to
